task.goal: Determine whether rare-event variance certificates can be acquired without paying equivalent event cost
task.question: Which structural assumptions or observation interfaces can remove rare-event-scale acquisition, and which cannot?
task.scope: Known product families and explicit DNF versus low-order-marginal-matching dependent laws

sources.read_depth: full original note plus reviewed wrappers

assumptions: Passive iid complete vectors for statistical lower bound
At most k coordinates per fresh specimen for exact transcript impossibility
Trusted exact product structure, p_j in [a,1-a], fixed explicit DNF for positive result
contract.interface: Low-order marginals supplied exactly; target-law identity unknown. Positive regime acquires ordinary component counts. Conditional sampling is separately charged.

costs.negative_samples: Omega(1/(epsilon^2 p)) with the stated confidence and kernel-positivity condition
costs.kernel_evaluation: O(d(k+1)) rational operations; O(k+1) workspace; O(db+d) actual bits
costs.kernel_sampling: Expected two rejection proposals, each using d component draws and one likelihood evaluation
costs.positive_calibration: O(d(1-a)/(a epsilon^2)) complete specimens per constant-confidence group; multiply by d for scalar observations
costs.positive_inner: O(M/epsilon^2) coverage samples per group; implemented per draw O(d+J+M)

inherited_or_supplied: Product independence and explicit complete DNF in positive regime
Known marginal support lower bound a

candidate.representation: High-degree reproducing-kernel likelihood perturbation, plus empirical product model and reciprocal DNF coverage
candidate.hypothesis: Many exact low-order marginals cannot certify an exponentially rare target; trusted full independence permits polynomial calibration for explicitly computable events

missing_lemma: A physically justified affordable observation/preparation interface that excludes hidden tail-relevant high-order dependence
comparator: Kuntz-Crucinio-Johansen product-form estimators; Karp-Luby-Madras weighted DNF; known k-wise independence and moment-matching constructions
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Any claimed low-cost validation must distinguish the explicit pair or state and charge the richer conditional/intervention access
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: Historical novelty of the specific kernel specialization
Applicability of exact product structure to a real experiment
Affordable acquisition of complete failure-mode list
status_note: Internal mathematical reconstruction, independent model criticism, exact finite checks, synthetic code only. Known-estimator composition, not new capability validation.
